etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: From Middle English overweninge, equivalent to overween +‎ -ing. Cognate with obsolete Dutch overwanig, overwaand (“presumptuous; cocky; conceited”).

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
paragraphs: From Middle English overweninge, equivalent to overween +‎ -ing.
senses: (now rare) An excessively high opinion of oneself or one’s abilities; presumption, arrogance.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 3
paragraphs: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
senses: present participle and gerund of overween
